headline: Monza HM done — solid execution, mission accomplished
summary: Finished in ~1:36:32 (21.18km, 5792s moving), inside the 1:37-1:40 target. Average HR 167 across the whole race — right in the prescribed 168-172 Z4 band for the main 1h block, and he never breached the 175 stop-rule threshold until the final push to 189 max in the last strides. Cadence 83.5, RPE 8, feel "1" (great) — this was a quality controlled hard effort, not a blowup. Compliance reads 78% because intervals.icu's load model undercounts a steady-state race effort like this against the interval-style target structure, but the HR-band and pace execution were clean; treat RPE 8 / feel 1 / finish time as the real quality signal here, not the compliance number.
flags: ATL jumped 43.6 -> 55.9 overnight on this one session (load 136) — expect legs heavy tomorrow, which is exactly why Wk4 is the recovery week.
Sleep last night was short (5h44m) and sleep score dipped to 73 going into the race — worth watching the next couple of nights but not a red flag given the result.
suggestedChange: None needed — Wk4 recovery plan (Tue easy 45, build back toward the Podgorica weekend) already accounts for today's race load. No change to propose.
